katalog.einleitung: Each component is shown here exactly as it is built in the prototype. Whoever builds a new screen uses these pages as the yardstick.

regel.zustaende: An element shows every state through a fixed channel so states never hide each other. The outline belongs to selection, hovering and another person, and exactly one wins: selected before other person before hovered. Status, visibility and surroundings always come on top. The accent stands only for selection and hovering.
regel.auswahl: There is exactly one selection for the whole window. Structure, model, properties and chat read it and change it only through the same commands. A click selects, Shift adds, Ctrl toggles, a click into empty space clears. With several elements the properties show only what they share.
regel.struktur-zeile: A row shows icon, name, status and the eye, all always visible. The selected row carries the accent surface, hovering carries the quiet surface. A double-click or Enter makes the element active. Rows can be dragged to move them.
regel.auge: The eye is always visible in every row, not only on hover. It hides only for this person; export stays untouched. Show everything brings everything back. Visibility is view and not a step in the history.
regel.kontextmenue: The context menu is generated from the command register and is the same in structure and model for the same selection. It is grouped by family, each group shows at most twelve entries, minor ones sit behind “More …”. Within a group the rank applies. Shortcuts stand next to the entry.
regel.kontextaktionen: The bar above the selection shows the first five entries of the context menu by rank, not a list of its own. It replaces the toolbar. Numbers never appear here but in the properties.
regel.dropdown: A dropdown of the menu bar shows all commands of its family in subgroups with at most twelve entries each. The content comes from the register, not by hand. Entries that do not fit are grey. The shortcut stands next to each entry.
regel.suche: Search finds commands and content in one field and opens with Ctrl and K. Results come from the command register and show their shortcut. Arrow keys choose, Enter runs, Esc closes. Commands without another place, such as help, are found only here.
regel.wertfeld: Every number stands as a quantity with a unit in a value field. You type the value, also with a unit or a simple formula, and accept with Enter; Esc restores the old value. While typing the model changes live. An unreadable entry shows a finding at the field.
regel.griff: On the selected element there is a handle for its length, for example the thickness. While dragging the value jumps in whole millimetres, the number stands at the pointer. Typing digits then sets that exact value. Releasing or Enter accepts, Esc cancels.
regel.ziehen-ablegen: A row can be dragged onto another to move it. A permitted target carries the accent surface, a forbidden one the error surface, and the reason appears in the feedback line. Parts and assemblies may go into an assembly, steps stay in their part. Esc cancels the drag, then nothing changes.
regel.statusanzeige: A status always appears as colour, icon and word together. It stands at the row in the structure and at the element in the model. Calculating, faulty and paused are the three states. A fault in one element never paralyses the whole model.
regel.befund: A finding says what is wrong, where, and how to fix it. It stands in the findings panel, and for a wrong entry also at the value field. The correction is a button, for example “Set last valid value”. All other elements stay usable.
regel.rueckmeldung: Confirmations and hints stand quietly in the narrow line at the very bottom. There are no dialogs and no messages anywhere else. The text says briefly what happened, without exclamation marks. Discarded items can be brought back with undo.
regel.entscheidungskarte: Every change by the AI appears as a card with a preview, never directly. The card says what changes, with the value before and after. Accept is the one main action and carries the accent. Only after accepting does the same command appear in the history, with the source AI.
regel.pfad: The path shows where you are working: from the root to the active element. A click on a link goes back there, a click on the root leaves the active element. The last link is emphasised. Done and Esc lead out the same way.
regel.dokument-reiter: The tabs above the model are documents, nothing else. There are no command tabs and no tabs within tabs. The chosen tab is emphasised. If another person works in a tab, it shows a small person icon.
regel.ansichtsleiste: The view bar in the model contains fit, zoom to selection, isolate, show everything, projection and display. More views and saving a view are in the menu at the edge of the bar. Everything here is view and never changes the graph. A saved view is stored explicitly as an element.
regel.fokus-tastatur: Every zone is reachable by Tab or F6, and focus is visible as a ring in the accent colour. Esc always closes exactly one level. There are at most fifteen shortcuts, and all stand in the command register and next to the command in the menu. Nothing is reachable by mouse alone.
